A small, curated set of field notes for exploring how equipment, style and luck change the shape of risk.

How to read this

The database records expeditions, members, summit attempts and deaths separately. There is no single natural “success rate”: change the definition and denominator above to see how much the story moves. Disputed records stay in the data unless you choose “Undisputed recorded summit.” The timeline now includes the early expeditionary era from 1900.
